record.category: traffic bundle (Vietnamese: prepaid download traffic that anyone can redeem without an account)

free_tier.stated: No free tier: traffic is bought up front. 'Dung lượng Traffic 200GB / 1000GB / 3000GB ... Giá bán 150.000 VNĐ / 600.000 VNĐ' (the 3000 GB price did not render on either read).
free_tier.notes: The unit is redeemed traffic, not stored bytes and not time.

retention.stated: 'Không giới hạn thời gian sử dụng' - the traffic balance does not expire
retention.notes: No expiry is the distinctive part: the bundle is a balance, not a subscription.

egress.terms: Traffic is consumed by other people's downloads of the link: 'dung lượng sẽ trừ dần đến hết tuỳ theo dung lượng file chia sẻ và số lượt người tải file'. Recipients download at high speed 'không cần đăng nhập tài khoản'.

record.interface_detail: Create a Directlink URL in the Fshare account; anyone with the URL downloads without signing in.
record.tooling: Browser; the generated link is a plain HTTP URL that any download manager or scraper can fetch, which is what makes it usable as a distribution path.
record.chaining: The only Vietnamese product found that prices bandwidth directly rather than time: one VND 600,000 bundle is a 1 TB distribution allowance that never expires, so it composes with any client that needs to serve files to third parties rather than to itself.

limits.value: 200 GB or 1000 GB of redeemed traffic per bundle

record.limits_note: No time limit at all; the entire constraint is the traffic balance.
record.binding_note: The bundle is pure volume, so 1 TiB/month needs one 1000 GB bundle per month; nothing else binds because there is no clock.

identity_cost.detail: Purchased through the same Fshare checkout as VIP and Fcode, which offers only Vietnamese rails (MoMo, ShopeePay, VNPAY, FPT Pay, SMS to 9029, domestic bank transfer). A recipient of the link needs nothing; the buyer is gated.

record.reliability_note: Traffic is consumed by strangers downloading the link, so a link posted publicly can burn a bundle in hours; there is no per-recipient cap and no refund of consumed traffic.
record.confidence_note: Page read twice (extract and raw); two of three prices are quotable and the third did not render. The purchase rail is inferred from the Fshare checkout pages read separately, which is why identity is country-phone rather than measured.

evidence.proved: 'Gói Directlink cho phép bạn tạo link tải nhanh cho file để chia sẻ với dung lượng lớn (3000GB)'; 'người nhận được link có thể tải file với tốc độ cao, không cần đăng ký tài khoản'
price table: 'Dung lượng Traffic 200GB 1000GB 3000GB ... Giá bán 150.000 VNĐ 600.000 VNĐ' and 'Không giới hạn thời gian sử dụng'

record.price_per_tb_month: VND 600,000 per 1 TB of redeemed traffic (no expiry)
record.notes: Volume-based distribution plan distinct from time-based personal VIP subscriptions. Traffic balances do not expire.

record.category: file host (Vietnamese: storage, direct download, Fcode per-download codes)

free_tier.stated: No free byte allowance is published on the pages read. The vendor sells access two ways: VIP from VND 3,000/day ('Siêu tiết kiệm, chỉ từ 3.000Đ/ ngày (VIP 30 ngày/ 90.000Đ)') and Fcode, a per-download code: '20.000 VND Cho 10 lượt tải/12h/50GB dung lượng tải' when bought through MoMo/ShopeePay/FPT Pay/VNPAY.
free_tier.notes: A free account exists and is what get-link shops resell access to; the site itself promotes VIP and Fcode as the paid paths. No free-tier quota sentence was found.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the pages read

retention.stated: not stated on the pages read; VIP includes '300GB lưu trữ trong đó có 50GB lưu trữ đảm bảo (file không bị xóa)'
retention.notes: The 50 GB is guaranteed storage inside the VIP quota, not a retention period.

egress.terms: VIP: 'tải dữ liệu với tốc độ tối đa lên đến 300GB mỗi ngày' (up to 300 GB per day at full speed). Fcode buys a 50 GB / 12 h bucket or a 4 h single download.
egress.free_allowance: 300 GB/day on VIP; 50 GB per Fcode

record.interface_detail: Public API host api.fshare.vn (the vendor's own payment and package pages live there); web download; Fshare Tool for Windows/macOS; mobile apps.
record.tooling: api.fshare.vn plus community Python clients published on PyPI (get-fshare, getlink_fshare) and several GitHub tools; no official rclone backend observed; the vendor's own Fshare Tool is the supported desktop path.
record.chaining: A Fshare VIP account is the upstream that a Vietnamese get-link shop resells, so paying Fshare directly replaces the shop; the 300 GB/day egress is 8.8x the 34 GB/day 1 TiB of monthly transfer needs, which makes Fshare throughput sufficient and the payment rail the only real obstacle.

limits.value: 50 GB per Fcode; 10 downloads per 12 h
no single-file cap published on the pages read

record.limits_note: Fcode validity is short by construction: 12 hours for the 50 GB wallet-code bucket, 4 hours for the single SMS purchase.
record.binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the requirement is 34 GB/day and the VIP allowance is 300 GB/day, so no throughput constraint binds. What stops a registrant outside the country is payment, recorded in identity_cost.

identity_cost.detail: Every published rail is Vietnamese: 'Mua Fcode bằng MoMo/ShopeePay/FPT Pay/VNPAY' or SMS 'FCODE gửi 8700 (Áp dụng cho các mạng Viettel, Mobifone, Vinaphone)'; VIP is also sold by domestic bank transfer to a named account. No card, PayPal or crypto rail appears on the Fcode or VIP pages.

record.reliability_note: Fcode delivery depends on a live QR scan inside a Vietnamese wallet app or an SMS from a Vietnamese carrier; a code that is not copied within the 12 h window is lost, and get-link shops report the Fshare get-link path itself as unstable.
record.confidence_note: Five vendor pages were read on 2026-10-23 (Fcode, VIP package, VIP benefits blog, api package page, 4share is separate). Buying a Fcode from outside Vietnam confirms the payment claim at measured; that purchase is what the record says cannot be done.

evidence.proved: '20.000 VND Cho 10 lượt tải/12h/50GB dung lượng tải khi mua Fcode bằng MoMo/ShopeePay/FPT Pay/VNPAY', '15.000 VNĐ cho 1 lượt tải/4h khi mua Fcode bằng SMS', 'FCODE gửi 8700 (Áp dụng cho các mạng Viettel, Mobifone, Vinaphone)'
VIP traffic cap and price: 'tải dữ liệu với tốc độ tối đa lên đến 300GB mỗi ngày'; 'Chỉ từ 3.000 đồng/ngày ... 300GB dung lượng mỗi ngày'
'Siêu tiết kiệm, chỉ từ 3.000Đ/ ngày (VIP 30 ngày/ 90.000Đ)'; 'Dung lượng lưu trữ: 300GB (gồm 50GB đảm bảo và 250GB lưu trữ có thời hạn)'
SMS VIP package: 'VIP 4 ngày - 15.000đ không giới hạn lượt tải', syntax 'BX FSHARE NAP15 FS gửi 9029' for Vinaphone/Mobifone and 'BX 15000 FSHARE FS gửi 9029' for Viettel

the host warns against the get-link layer and names why the shops are unreliable: 'người dùng sẽ bị giới hạn dung lượng dữ liệu tải, số lượng lượt tải trong ngày ... tốc độ tải không ổn định, dữ liệu khi tải xuống bị đứt quãng'

record.price_per_tb_month: VND 90,000 per 30 days (VIP, 300 GB/day cap); VND 20,000 per 50 GB Fcode
record.notes: The Vietnamese host at the centre of the local get-link economy. Read directly rather than through a comparison site. The storage plan (1 TB-100 TB, VND 450,000 per 3 months for 1 TB per FPT's page) is a separate product and is not what the get-link shops resell. Trigger condition: Fshare publishes a card or international rail for Fcode.

extras.fpt_reseller_page: https://fpt.vn/vi/khach-hang-ca-nhan/san-pham-dich-vu/dich-vu-online/fshare.html lists Storage 1TB at VND 450,000/3 months and VND 1,500,000/year

card.summary: Free tier: 50 GB of 'dung lượng không đảm bảo' (non-guaranteed capacity). From 2027-01-01 the platform rebrands to FshareStorage, guaranteed capacity rises 5...

free_tier.stated: Free tier: 50 GB of 'dung lượng không đảm bảo' (non-guaranteed capacity). From 2027-01-01 the platform rebrands to FshareStorage, guaranteed capacity rises 50 GB -> 100 GB, and the free account tier is discontinued entirely.

retention.stated: Free accounts terminated 2027-01-01; data on any free account surviving to that date is kept a maximum of 30 days.

egress.terms: Download speed capped at 500 KB/s on Free ('Tốc độ tải xuống với 500KB/s'), which is per-ip-shaping in practice. VIP is 300 GB and sold from 3,000 VND/day.

record.tooling: Web + Windows/sync client. No public API, no rclone backend. FPT is the parent ISP.
record.chaining: 50 GB x N FPT accounts, all of it non-guaranteed. But this is a closing door, not an opening one: free accounts stop existing in ~2 months.
record.limits_note: per-ip-shaping: 500 KB/s download on Free. 50 GB non-guaranteed storage. Free accounts terminated 2027-01-01; data on any free account surviving to that date is kept a maximum of 30 days.
record.reliability_note: The single most important thing about Fshare is the dated announcement: the free tier is being killed on 2027-01-01 and free-tier data gets a 30-day guillotine regardless of download activity. Anything built on it has a hard expiry date two months out.

evidence.proved: 'Dịch vụ sẽ dừng cung cấp tài khoản miễn phí từ ngày 01/01/2027', free-account data 'tối đa 30 ngày', guaranteed capacity 'từ 50GB lên 100GB'
'dung lượng miễn phí là 50GB', 'Tốc độ tải xuống với 500KB/s', 'KHÔNG giới hạn DUNG LƯỢNG tập tin TẢI LÊN'

record.notes: Free tier: 50 GB of 'dung lượng không đảm bảo' (non-guaranteed capacity). From 2027-01-01 the platform rebrands to FshareStorage, guaranteed capacity rises 50 GB -> 100 GB, and the free account tier is discontinued entirely.
